article_notes: Case series of 8 dogs with PCR-confirmed B. vogeli (Kerala). Two dogs were SIRS positive (Matijatko et al. 2010) and one of them died; per-dog vital signs and WBC are tabulated (Tables 3 and 5) but there is no per-group summary or test of any marker between SIRS-positive and SIRS-negative dogs or by outcome, and the SIRS variables themselves define the groups. Haematology was tested only against standard reference values (one-sample t-test, Table 4), which is not a severity comparison.

not_extracted.what: Per-dog data by SIRS status and outcome (Tables 2, 3, 5, 6)
not_extracted.note: n=2 SIRS positive vs 6 negative; individual values only, no summary or test.
